requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-4875-5361--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Conspiracy, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Auton Soldier. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Conspiracy, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1170-3389-5334-5954-8345.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1477-4694-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1477-4694-4802-7306.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Extruder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on the targeted creature.
Repeat from step 1.

997-2738-4871-7316.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Rat King, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2034-3197-4153--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature token dies, Resourceful Defense triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Repeat from step 5.

2103-4015-7757.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn with {1}{R} each extra turn
2103-4015-7757.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack and that cannot be blocked or killed by an opponent.
2103-4015-7757.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare any creature as an attacker. When you do, Doom's Time Platform triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard with two time counters on it.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Rift Elemental by paying {1}{R} and removing a time counter from Capture of Jingzhou.
Capture of Jingzhou's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 2.

240-719-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Xenograft, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-719-6797.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

1432-4513-4747.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 2 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
1432-4513-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}
Activate Saryth by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Saryth and Alena
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any additional creature without summoning sickness you control

requires.n: Permanent with Landfall Ability: Create Creature Token(s)

433-3259-3861--85--106.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
433-3259-3861--85--106.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
Orzhov Basilica enters the battlefield, triggering itself and the permanent with a landfall ability.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the landfall trigger, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token from step 4, untap all creatures you control, and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1251-2713-3094-4659-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
1251-2713-3094-4659-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

141-3771-7101.description:
Cast Airbending Lesson by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Animar.
Animar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Airbending Lesson targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Airbending Lesson, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {2} reduced by Animar.
Repeat from step 3.
141-3771-7101.notes: The mana cost can be reduced by {3} if Animar has two or more +1/+1 counters on it when the combo begins. If Animar has one +1/+1 counter, the cost is reduced by {2}.

2366-5223-5234-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-5223-5234-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Heartbeat of Spring triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

236-539-3899-4552-6441.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Animating Faerie // Bring to Life.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-4087-4853.description:
Activate Lavabrink Floodgates by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Lavabrink Floodgates.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3532-4842-5078-6556.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1844-2921-5571--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is 2 or greater.
1844-2921-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Siren of the Silent Song

1557-3525-3755.description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard a card and mill a card.
Repeat.

2232-4865-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-4865-6749.description:
Cast Vesuvan Shapeshifter by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Vesuvan Shapeshifter from the battlefield to your hand.
When Vesuvan Shapeshifter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Vesuvan Shapeshifter from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

1456-4908-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

654-5413-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
654-5413-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Repeat.

224-280-654-1772.description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it, Amulet of Vigor and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Golgari Rot Farm
Holding priority, activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger from step 2, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.

5230-6464.description:
Declare Terisian Mindbreaker as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing the defending player to mill half their library, rounded up.
Activate Keening Stone by paying {5} and tapping it, causing the player to mill cards equal to the number of cards in their graveyard, thus milling the rest of their library.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

413-5263-6243.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
When Optimus Prime, Hero enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve both Blasting Station abilities from steps 1 and 4.
Repeat.

81-5137-6287.notablePrerequisites:
Mimeoplasm does not have summoning sickness and has power 6 or greater.
Morphling and Kami of Whispered Hopes are exiled by Mimeoplasm.
81-5137-6287.description:
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Mimeoplasm by tapping it, adding at least six {U}.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Morphling.
Activate Mimeoplasm by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

437-509-3094-4131-5517.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{R} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
437-509-3094-4131-5517.notablePrerequisites: Sphinx's Disciple has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
437-509-3094-4131-5517.description:
Cast Idris either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{U}{R} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Idris enters the battlefield, its imprint ability triggers, targeting Sphinx's Disciple.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Idris' trigger, targeting Basalt Monolith.
Resolve both Idris triggers, exiling Basalt Monolith and Sphinx's Disciple.
During your next turn, activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Idris using Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 5.

116-215-2404-3464.notablePrerequisites:
Kiora's Follower does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other creatures.
116-215-2404-3464.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout to your hand.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters, it triggers itself, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Kiora's Follower any number of times.

277-1021-2167-3470.description:
Activate Drownyard Temple's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing Drownyard Temple, adding {C}.
Activate Drownyard Temple's second ability by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Drownyard Temple enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Drownyard Temple.
Repeat.

1322-3259-3349.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
1322-3259-3349.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Glissa triggers, creating two Incubator artifact tokens with two +1/+1 counters on them.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature you control, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
At the beginning of your next combat phase, Glissa triggers, transforming all Incubators you control into 0/0 Phyrexian artifact creatures.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

878-3059-4847.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ziatora triggers, causing you to sacrifice Malignus, then deal damage equal to twice Malignus' power to an opponent, and create three Treasure tokens.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

413-1628-4186.notablePrerequisites:
Necrosynthesis attached to Scurry Oak.
You control another creature to sacrifice.
413-1628-4186.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing a creature, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Necrosynthesis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Squirrel token, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.

678-2459-5147.description:
Sacrifice Rograkh to Goblin Bombardment to do 1 damage to an opponent.
Enduring Renewal returns Rograkh to your hand.
Cast Rograkh.
Repeat.
